memberships_branch_role_check.name: memberships_branch_role_check
memberships_branch_role_check.value: ("memberships"."role" = 'school_admin' and "memberships"."branch_id" is null) or ("memberships"."role" <> 'school_admin' and "memberships"."branch_id" is not null)

content_items_scope_check.name: content_items_scope_check
content_items_scope_check.value:
("content_items"."scope" = 'school' and "content_items"."branch_id" is null and "content_items"."section_id" is null)
        or ("content_items"."scope" = 'branch' and "content_items"."branch_id" is not null and "content_items"."section_id" is null)
        or ("content_items"."scope" = 'section' and "content_items"."branch_id" is not null and "content_items"."section_id" is not null)
